verdict.notes: No edit occurred (before/after identical in both renderers), but the app render shows the two checklist panes as completely empty boxes while the raw browser render shows their content ('Ship steps' list and 'Rollback plan' paragraph), so the renderers do not agree.

In every AFTER render 'ship the retro notes' appears as a plain unbulleted paragraph below the list rather than as a fourth bullet item, so the instruction failed structurally, though app and raw browser show identical content.

In all renders the Summary section heading becomes 'Executive summary' with body text and other sections unchanged (the TOC link text was not part of the instruction), and app and raw renders show identical content — the raw AFTER only loses the TOC box styling/spacing, which is ignorable chrome.
